{{Quote|I am a merc, bub. I work for credits not for some misplaced ideal of those soldier boys.|Colonel Gurnst, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TFB" />}}
'''Gurnst''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Gurnst was hired by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in order to squelch the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:TFB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Colonel Gurnst was stationed in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] where he recruited many spacers visiting Kashyyyk to join [[Task Force Bravo]] in the fight against the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] freedom fighters.<ref name="SWG:TFB" />
